title: Expanded My Intraday Scanner From 500 to 1,150+ Tickers — Signal Quality Actually Improved
author: BotandBull
selftext: Running an automated intraday momentum bot on Robinhood. Was scanning S&P 500 only. Added the S&P 600 (mid-cap) last week. Results surprised me. What changed: - Mid-caps produce cleaner entry signals. Less algo competition at these price levels means less noise in the momentum data. - Fill quality improved. Smaller stocks filled tighter than expected. - Signal volume went up but false positive rate stayed flat. My filters held up well at scale. Infrastructure: DigitalOcean VPS ($12/month), Python bot scanning during market hours. Biggest concern was API rate limits with 2x the ticker list. Solved it by reordering my filter pipeline so the expensive calls only run on stocks that pass the cheap checks first.
